plugins._comment: PLACEHOLDER — Google's public SAMPLE app IDs, not Albor's. Ads earn nothing until real AdMob app IDs replace them AND src/utils/ads.js PROD_* unit IDs are filled in with USE_TEST_ADS=false. Ads stay off in the EEA/UK regardless — see src/utils/adRegion.js.
plugins.userTrackingUsageDescription: This identifier will be used to deliver personalized ads to you.

plugins.microphonePermission: Albor, hikayeleri sesli olarak kaydedip dinleyebilmen için mikrofona erişmek ister.

revenuecat._comment: PLACEHOLDER — a RevenueCat Test Store key. src/services/billing.js treats any test_* key as unset, so BILLING_LIVE is false and the paywall cannot take money (it shows paywallUnavailable* instead of granting Premium). Replace with the real appl_*/goog_* public SDK keys. See BILLING_SETUP.md.

posthog._comment: PostHog deliberately OFF for now — apiKey is a placeholder, so src/utils/analytics.js never initializes the client (ANALYTICS_LIVE=false): no init, no network calls, no autocapture. To turn analytics back on later, create a PostHog EU Cloud project (not this old US-host key/project) and put its real key + https://eu.i.posthog.com here.
